Hi all —

Reviewed Novaforge's marked PDF and the draft order form. High-level intake below; attaching Redwood_Standard_MSA_v2.docx with track changes for your reference.

Summary (items that will likely require negotiation):
- Data Processing / Processor Appendix: Redwood accepts acting as a Processor but we need the appendix to reference our standard DPA language. Novaforge's proposed text introduces additional audit rights and a very broad data return/destruction clause — we can accept with edits. Suggest we propose Redwood's DPA appendix, and allow a one-time audit with notice and scope limits.
- Subprocessors: we maintain a public registry; we'll provide the link. We cannot agree to unilateral right for customer to block a subprocessor without escalation steps (we can add a 30-day notice + CMP/escalation path).
- IP carve-out: Novaforge asked to exclude models trained on customer data from Redwood's general model improvements. This is material. We can offer a compromise: customer data will not be included in model training for shared models unless customer opts in via a separate agreement; otherwise we retain model improvements but ensure trained-on-customer-data cannot be reverse-engineered to reproduce customer PII. Need commercial sign-off.

Non-material / acceptable with minor edits:
- Liability caps: redlines appear within our acceptable range for this deal size after manager approval.
- Termination for convenience: standard language is fine with minor clarifications.

Attachments: Redwood_Standard_MSA_v2.docx (tracked changes).
Links: Subprocessors registry: https://status.redwood.com/subprocessors

Request: Kimberly/Karthik — please confirm: (1) whether Sales can accept the suggested IP compromise, and (2) whether we should offer a one-time data processor audit (with scope limits) or push for attestation + SOC2 evidence only. Once you confirm, I'll prepare a redline that merges Redwood's tracked changes into Novaforge's PDF and return a single consolidated PDF.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
